design_row_ec: Ethics Committee package and consent form
design_locked: Your saved Design and ethics work is locked. Unlock your vault to read it and save your changes.
design_broken: Part of your saved Design and ethics work cannot be opened on this device. Nothing was changed.
design_broken_confirm: This part of your saved Design and ethics work cannot be opened on this device. Saving now replaces it. Save anyway?
design_error: Your last save did not go through. What you entered is kept here and is sent with your next change.
design_read_failed: Your saved Design and ethics work could not be read just now. Nothing was changed. Reload the page to try again.
design_reg_intro: Answer four questions and get a starting list of which approvals usually apply in India. This is a checklist to walk in with, not a ruling. Your institution's Ethics Committee has the final word.
design_reg_type_observational: Observational: no intervention, just measuring or surveying
design_reg_type_interventional: Interventional: a behavioral or psychological intervention, no drug or device
design_reg_type_device: Interventional: involves an investigational device (including a brain-wave or neuro device)
design_reg_pop_adults: General adults, able to consent for themselves
design_reg_pop_vulnerable: Cognitively impaired, institutionalised, or otherwise vulnerable adults
design_reg_bio: Collects blood, saliva, genetic or other biological samples
design_reg_multi: Runs at more than one site or institution
design_reg_committee: Only your committee can say that, in writing.
design_insert_failed: Nothing was inserted. Open your document and try again.
design_proto_intro: Fill in each section in your own words. "Generate" assembles them into one structured document you can drop straight into your document editor, or hand to a funder or your EC.
design_proto_bg_ph: What's known already, the gap, why this study is needed now
design_proto_obj_ph: Primary objective, secondary objectives, directional hypotheses
design_proto_design_ph: Study type, groups/arms, randomisation if any, blinding if any
design_proto_part_ph: Who is eligible, who is excluded and why
design_proto_sample_ph: Target N and how you got there. Use the Statistics Lab's calculators if you have an expected effect size
design_proto_proc_ph: What a participant actually does, in order, from recruitment to debrief
design_proto_risk_ph: What could go wrong, how you'll manage it, what participants or the field gain
design_proto_dmp_ph: Where data lives, who can see it, how it's anonymised, how long you keep it
design_ec_intro: The documents an EC typically asks for, and a generator for the informed consent form itself. Check a box as each document is ready.
design_ec_record_desc: Write down what your committee decided. Appuscholar never decides it for you.
design_ec_status_none: Not yet sent to a committee
design_ec_status_noreview: The committee told me in writing that full review is not needed
design_ec_committee_ph: e.g. Institutional Ethics Committee, Department of Psychology
design_ec_consentmode: How participants agree to take part
design_ec_consent_online: Tick-box consent before an online form
design_ec_statement: Insert an ethics statement into my document
design_consent_title_ph: e.g. EEG correlates of sustained attention in college students
design_consent_risks_ph: Be specific and honest, even if minor
design_consent_benefits_ph: To the participant directly, and/or to the field
design_consent_contact_ph: PI email/phone, and the EC's own contact
